```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)

# Load Australia/Tasmania state boundaries
aus <- ne_states(country = "australia", returnclass = "sf")

# Define your population colors (matching your original scheme)
pop_colours <- c(
  "Frederick Henry &\nStorm Bays"               = "#1a6b8a",
  "St Helens &\nShelly Points"                  = "#e07b39",
  "Actaeon Island, Sisters\n& Recherche Bays"   = "#2e8b57",
  "Mersey & Leven\nRiver Mouths"                = "#8b2fc9",
  "Wilderness Coast"                            = "#c0392b"
)

# Site Data (Simplified for high-level PowerPoint visibility)
sites_all <- data.frame(
  population = c(
    rep("Actaeon Island, Sisters\n& Recherche Bays", 5),
    rep("Frederick Henry &\nStorm Bays", 3),
    rep("St Helens &\nShelly Points", 5),
    rep("Mersey & Leven\nRiver Mouths", 3),
    "Wilderness Coast"
  ),
  lon = c(147.02, 147.17, 147.10, 146.92, 146.99, 147.59, 147.65, 147.34, 
          148.35, 148.27, 148.32, 148.26, 148.30, 146.16, 146.37, 147.38, 149.50),
  lat = c(-43.42, -43.28, -43.39, -43.57, -43.52, -42.86, -42.90, -43.04, 
          -41.28, -41.43, -40.92, -40.89, -40.94, -41.13, -41.16, -40.98, -37.75)
)

# Summarize into 5 central points so the map isn't cluttered at small sizes
pop_summary <- sites_all %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarize(lon = mean(lon), lat = mean(lat))

p_ppt <- ggplot() +
  # Draw the landmass with clean white borders
  geom_sf(data = aus, fill = "grey92", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  
  # Focus the window on the study regions
  coord_sf(xlim = c(143.5, 150.5), ylim = c(-44, -37.5), expand = FALSE) +
  
  # Large, high-visibility points for the 5 populations
  geom_point(data = pop_summary, 
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = population), 
             shape = 21, size = 8, stroke = 1.5, colour = "black") +
  
  # Bold labels with white background shadows for legibility
  geom_text_repel(data = pop_summary,
                  aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = population),
                  size = 4.5, 
                  fontface = "bold",
                  lineheight = 0.9,
                  box.padding = 1.5, 
                  point.padding = 0.8,
                  bg.color = "white", 
                  bg.r = 0.15,
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  
  # Apply colors and clean "void" theme for slides
  scale_fill_manual(values = pop_colours) +
  theme_void() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )

# Display plot
p_ppt

# This will save a high-resolution version to your project folder
ggsave("Kelp_Study_Map_For_PPT.png", p_ppt, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```
